summary: Citizens, Inc. filed an 8-K on October 9, 2026, disclosing entry on October 5, 2026 into a Master Software as a Service Agreement with Bestow Agency LLC, plus a Build Order and Run Order, effective October 1, 2026. The arrangement provides a white-labeled, agent-assisted digital platform to quote, apply, underwrite, issue and administer the company's final expense simplified issue whole life products through CICA Life Insurance Company of America. Citizens retains underwriting rules, pricing, regulatory filings, agent licensing and claims. No board recommendation, advisor, ownership stake, price or termination fee is stated; this is a routine technology contract, not a special situation.
